nodes.label: browser connect (remote-control a browser you don't launch)
nodes.rationale: Last resort, below handover: attach to the user's own logged-in Chrome over CDP (through any http tunnel, with the debug websocket host rewritten) or to a remote Camoufox over native BiDi. Stealth is Camoufox's job; a connected Chrome is driven as-is with the user's real profile, which is the point. browser stop never kills a browser it did not launch.

hyperedges.label: Browser trust escalation ladder: stealth, then handover, then remote control
